oversizedPayloadBoundary.boundary: the installed harness concatenates tool-call argument deltas verbatim, drops the WHOLE call on a max-tokens finish, and parses with a plain JSON.parse (no size cap, no key filter) — so a trailing key lost inside a dispatched call cannot have been dropped by this layer; it was never emitted by the model, and the plugin-side REQUIRED-parameter contract is the only honest guard
